problem_restatement: One portfolio-wide 14-day zero-entry clock cannot distinguish a relatively frequent cash-open route from structurally sparse breakout and sweep routes.
decision: Add exact-route report-only zero-signal review clocks. Crossing a clock opens a cadence-deviation investigation; it does not reject, pause, retune, resize, or change a live route.

selection_rule.description: Choose a bounded review horizon corresponding to roughly two or more events under the frozen historical cadence where feasible, while preserving the existing 14-day HYPE review and avoiding an indefinite wait for the sparse BTC routes.

hype_breakout_compression_alignment_bidi.historical_cadence: 41 causal development trades over approximately 304 days; later evidence remains sparse

hip3_spcx_cash_open_gap_reversal_bidirec.historical_cadence: approximately 3.94 development trades per week; OOS remains sealed

hulk_expansion_short_tuned_v2|BTC.historical_cadence: 106 completed trades over 338 covered days, approximately 2.2 per week

hulk_expansion_short_robust_v3|BTC.historical_cadence: one exact forward signal over 12.5 covered days

liquidity_sweep_long_1h_stop60_target60_.historical_cadence: six development signals over 92 days and one forward signal over 12.5 days

validation_plan.signal_identity: Use exact current-profile strategy_id|symbol eligible-signal counts from the backend-authored strategy scorecard.
validation_plan.coverage: A clock cannot become due when checkpoint coverage is incomplete or has technical gaps.
validation_plan.history: Elapsed countdown changes are excluded from the material-change hash; status transitions remain material.
validation_plan.authority: Every clock is report-only with execution_authority none and automatic_live_change false.

limitations: Historical cadence may not remain stationary under the current regime.
The Poisson calculation is a transparent sensitivity, not a validated arrival model or rejection threshold.
Cash-session holidays and route overlap are not modeled by elapsed wall-clock time.
A due review requests diagnosis only; it is not evidence that a strategy is broken.
An observed eligible signal closes the zero-signal clock but does not establish execution quality or profitability.
falsifiers: An exact route emits an eligible signal before its threshold, in which case its clock must report signal_observed.
Technical coverage becomes incomplete, in which case no route clock may report review_due.
Live evidence shows that route evaluations are not attributable by exact strategy_id and symbol.
A later validated arrival model materially changes the appropriate diagnostic horizons.
